ja.html: 村正 《磁装ながれ・負極かえる！》
ja.text:
村正
《磁装ながれ・負極かえる！》

en.html:
A barrier of repelling magnetism swept the enemy's battle-axe off in an entirely different direction. Naturally, I was completely unhurt.

If the enemy retained any reasonable portion of its senses, this ought to have left it looking thoroughly bewitched.

A pity I could not verify the expression...
